title: story-051, commit 267660b and the UniPoolerV2 tests credit the sync-before-sizing fix to 'ycn20l24' (L-24, wont-fix) instead of ycn20l25 / L-25 (8ec2be7d59); the canonical-pair change that remediates Q-19 carries no label
description: In the ledger, ycn20l24 is L-24 (8511fd5206, wont-fix): the constructor checks only the pair's token set and not that it is the factory's canonical pair, plus the dust pre-seed grief. The sync finding is ycn20l25 / L-25 (8ec2be7d59, fix-pending). So the story, the commit and the tests credit the sync fix to a wont-fix entry. The canonical-pair change (#3), which does remediate the non-canonical-decoupling half of the real L-24, carries no label at all.
impact: None on-chain. The hazard is to audit-ledger traceability only.
likelihood: Moderate that a human closer is misled. The failure modes are fail-safe or noisy, never fail-silent (see justification).
assumptions: A closer selects by the issueId string in story/commit/tests instead of by fingerprint
severityJustification: Story-051, commit 267660b and two tests credit the sync-before-sizing fix to 'ycn20l24'. That ID is L-24 8511fd5206, a wont-fix about a dust pre-seed. The fix actually remediates L-25 8ec2be7d59. The canonical-pair change that closes Q-19 098396142d carries no label at all. I checked whether this could make a closer act on the wrong ledger entry. It could, but every misdirection fails safe or fails loud. (a) L-25 and Q-19 are not closed. They stay fix-pending, which is never suppressed, so they keep being rescanned. That is safe. (b) L-24 could be flipped from wont-fix to fixed. Both statuses are suppressed, and if L-24's still-live dust pre-seed (untouched by 267660b, see MR21-08) were seen again it would surface as a REGRESSION. That is a false alarm, not a hidden bug. No path silently suppresses a live finding, so there is no Law-1 hazard and nothing to support Low. There is a minor indirect risk: a reader who believes 'ycn20l24 was fixed' could drop the MR21-08 / L-24 cutover guidance (create-and-seed atomically, derive floors only from quotePool). The impact of skipping that guidance is already owner-accepted as 'mild inconvenience', and a keeper using quotePool refuses to pool on ts==0. This is a traceability and faithfulness defect: report it as F-01-051 at informational severity, visible to the owner, and do not bundle it into QA.
recommendation: Amend story-051 and the test labels (UniPoolerV2.t.sol:1604, UniPoolerV2.fork.t.sol:126) to ycn20l25, and cite ycn20q19 for the canonical-pair check. Until then, the /ledger closer must select by fingerprint (8ec2be7d, 09839614) and never by 'ycn20l24'.
